title: Te Ārai i te Whare Tawhito
intro: I roto i te tāone tapu, i mura te riri o tētahi tangata whai mana i te tīmatanga o te horapa o tētahi karere hou. Ko tēnei tangata, nōna nei te ingoa i mōhiotia whānuitia hei whakahē i te pono, i mātakitaki i te hinganga o tō rātou mana i raro i te taumaha o te whakakitenga tapu. Ko wai tēnei wairua, nōna nei te mutunga i hiritia ki te onepu o tētahi papa pakanga rongonui?
clues: He rangatira ahau i roto i tōku iwi, i mōhiotia mō ōku taonga me tōku mana i roto i tētahi tāone i reira tētahi wāhi tapu tawhito.
I te tīmatanga o tētahi tangata o tōku iwi ki te kauwhau i te karere a te Atua kotahi, ka tawai ahau ki a ia me āna whakakitenga, ka kī he kōrero noa iho ēnei nō mua.
I tū atu ahau ki taua tangata i a ia e inoi ana i te taha o te whare tapu, me te whakawehi ka mutu tana karakia mā te kaha mēnā e tika ana.
I roto ahau i ngā kaiārahi i whakatakoto mahere hei whakamutu i te whakapono hou, i te whakahē i ōna akonga ki ngā kupu me ngā patu.
I haere tahi mātou me tētahi ope taua ki tētahi wāhi e kiia nei ko Pātara, me te u o te whakaaro ka taea e mātou te patu i te rōpū iti o te hunga whakapono.
Engari i taua pakanga, ka mutu tōku ora, ā, ka waiho tōku matenga hei akoranga mā te hunga e tohe tonu ana ki te kore whakapono i muri i ngā tohu mārama.
